result:
No risk at Likelihood 3 or higher is unsettled. `bun tools/check-register.ts` exited 0 and reported 0 for each check across 436 items, including 0 for "Likelihood 3 or higher and not closed, accepted, mitigated, transferred or Moved Out".

The script does not look at entries with several Status lines. I checked those with my own parse of the ten register files, taking the last Status line as the current one. That parse is mine, not the script's, and I did not cross-check it against the script. 17 entries at Likelihood 3 or higher carry more than one Status line, and all 17 currently read `mitigated` or `closed`.

| Entry | L | Current status | Reason recorded |
|---|---|---|---|
| RISK-374 | 5 | mitigated 2026-11-18 | The spawn-depth and concurrency caps take effect, and Opus and Fable spawns are refused. |
| RISK-393 | 3 | mitigated 2026-11-19 | The fill writes no `Bash(claude -p *)` allow and removes the old one, so a paid `claude -p` run meets the permission prompt. An earlier acceptance was withdrawn because accepting a risk is the user's call. |
| RISK-166 | 4 | closed 2026-11-19 | Not reproduced on vanilla 2.1.327. |
| RISK-170 | 4 | mitigated 2026-11-18 | Covered by the shipped agent files. |
| RISK-171 | 4 | mitigated 2026-11-19 | The consent paragraph in the output style and the three agent files beats vanilla on r171b and r171d and holds level on both controls. |
| RISK-186 | 5 | mitigated 2026-11-19 | The Bash wrapper made every git command in an isolated worktree non-simple, so it was refused. Git commands are now left unwrapped, and a fake-API probe showed `git status` refused before the fix and run after it. The entry records a residual: model-written expansions still get refused, with Likelihood staying 5 and Impact 2. |
| RISK-053 | 4 | mitigated 2026-11-19 | The wall guard now folds `~/./`, `~//` and `~/x/..` spellings and escapes `[`. `wall.test.ts` covers all four, and the plugin tests ran 91 pass, 0 fail. |
| RISK-103 | 4 | mitigated 2026-11-19 | `rules.ts` adds middle-wildcard forms. A probe denied all seven force-push and stash forms tried, and 88 plugin tests passed. |
| RISK-226, 262, 264, 352, 353 | 4–5 | mitigated 2026-11-19 | The defect paragraph in the output style beats vanilla on two fixtures and holds level on both controls. |
| RISK-227 | 3 | mitigated 2026-11-19 | The output style plus the redact guard beat vanilla (env1 5/6 vs 1/6, env2 6/6 vs 0/6) and hold level on controls (6/6 each). |
| RISK-424 | 3 | mitigated 2026-11-18 | The threshold test pins the literal 70000. |
| RISK-451 | 4 | mitigated 2026-11-19 | The output-style paragraph on background exit status beats vanilla on r451a and r451d and holds level on the r451c control. |

Several of these were reopened and re-settled the same day, for example RISK-226, 227, 262, 264, 352, 353 and 451. In most of them an early `closed` or `accepted` was overturned, and the entry settled only with the later `mitigated` line.

I did not re-run any of the recorded probes or tests.
